```{python}
import sys

```

Unit: one representative genome per species. Codon and amino-acid frequencies come from protein-coding transcripts only (coding sequences and their translations); each genome contributes one frequency vector, so large genomes do not dominate. The phylum tab comes first; subphylum, class and order are the other tabs.

## Codon usage

```{python}
fig("C01_codon_heatmap", "Mean codon frequency per group.")
fig("C01b_rscu_heatmap", "Relative synonymous codon usage (RSCU) per group.")
fig("C02_rscu_boxes", "RSCU per codon across genomes.")
```

## GC at the third codon position

```{python}
fig("C04_gc3", "GC3 (GC at the third codon position) per genome.")
fig("C04b_gc3_vs_gc", "GC3 against genome GC.", "70%")
```
